title: Gemini 3.7 Flash
summary:
Google has introduced Gemini 3.7 Flash, its most intelligent workhorse model for coding and agents, released just three weeks after 3.6 Flash. It delivers substantial improvements in software engineering, knowledge work, and web development, with an introductory price of $0.75/1M input tokens and $3.75/1M output tokens — half the original 3.6 Flash cost.

Key performance gains over 3.6 Flash include: FrontierCode 1.1 Main (43.6% vs 34.4%), DeepSWE v1.1 (65.3% vs 49.0%), WebDev Arena Elo (1588 vs 1538), GDP.pdf benchmark (34.0% vs 22.0%), and AutomationBench (30.4% vs 17.0%). The model shows improved debugging, first-pass code accuracy, UI generation, and document processing for fields like finance, law, and biosciences.

Developer experience is enhanced with better instruction-following, intent clarification, multi-step planning, and tool calls, reducing manual oversight. Gemini Spark, available to Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers, now runs on 3.7 Flash for improved Workspace tool use and knowledge work.

The model ships with updated safety safeguards against CBRN and cyber-offense misuse. Availability includes Google Antigravity, Gemini API via Google AI Studio and Android Studio, Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, and the Gemini app for subscribers.

相较于3.6 Flash的主要性能提升包括：FrontierCode 1.1 Main（43.6%对34.4%）、DeepSWE v1.1（65.3%对49.0%）、WebDev Arena Elo（1588对1538）、GDP.pdf基准测试（34.0%对22.0%）以及AutomationBench（30.4%对17.0%）。该模型在调试、首次通过代码准确率、UI生成以及金融、法律和生物科学等领域的文档处理方面均表现出改进。

title: Accelerating GPT-5.6 Sol Ultrafast
summary:
Cerebras and OpenAI have introduced **Ultrafast Mode**, a new service tier in the OpenAI API powered by Cerebras hardware. It runs **GPT-5.6 Sol** at up to **750 output tokens per second** with no quality compromise, targeting time-sensitive, mission-critical AI work.

Key highlights:

- **Benchmark speed**: On Humanity’s Last Exam, GPT-5.6 Sol Ultrafast completed 2,500 PhD-level questions in **11 hours 11 minutes**, versus **78 hours 27 minutes** for Claude Fable 5—nearly **7× faster** with comparable accuracy.
- **Economic value**: On GDP-Val, Ultrafast delivered a **5.6× end-to-end speedup** without quality degradation, useful for legal, financial, and engineering tasks.
- **Use cases**: Enables fast root-cause analysis for production outages, real-time cybersecurity response, and smoother agent workflows without context-switching.
- **Technical innovation**: Powered by Cerebras’ **Wafer-Scale Engine**, which packs **44 GB of SRAM** on-chip so model weights stay resident, avoiding GPU-style memory bottlenecks and enabling fast, scalable inference.
- **Availability**: Ultrafast is currently in **limited preview** for select customers, with broader access planned as capacity grows.

The article highlights how Cerebras and OpenAI are removing the traditional speed-versus-intelligence tradeoff, allowing frontier AI to be applied to high-stakes, latency-sensitive work.

title: Donkey.bas is 45 Years Old – 131 line of Glory
summary:
The article celebrates the 45th anniversary of *Donkey.bas*, the classic 131-line BASIC game. It highlights the game’s enduring legacy as a simple yet iconic piece of early PC gaming history.

Key information includes the game’s controls and features: players use **Spacebar** or **tap** to switch lanes, and **Esc** to return to the title screen. The article also references options such as **Sound**, **CRT** (simulating a retro monitor), **Cheat**, and **FullScreen**, which are likely part of a modern web-based recreation.

Overall, the piece emphasizes how *Donkey.bas*, despite its modest 131 lines of code, remains a memorable and influential title — showcasing the creativity and simplicity of early software development.

title: Mistral OCR 4.1

title: Spaghettifying DRAM
summary:
This article describes a hardware security research project called "skitter-creek-bath-salts" that exploits DRAM address scrambling on AMD Family 16h CPUs to bypass memory protections and access otherwise locked platform regions.

The core vulnerability lies in the memory controller (MCT/DCT) layer, the final stage of the virtual-to-physical memory translation pipeline. The DRAM controller rewrites physical addresses into raw DRAM coordinates (bank, row, column) using a vendor-configurable transform. A simple one-bit write to the DCT's bank-swizzle-mode register (`xor dword [0xf80c2094], 0x00400000`) scrambles this mapping, causing physical addresses to alias to different DRAM cells. Critically, the security fences guarding protected regions (Platform Security Processor, SMM, C6 DRAM, microcode) operate on physical addresses *above* the memory controller and never see the remapping below — so they are silently bypassed.

Keeping the system stable during the scramble requires careful orchestration: disabling application processors, priming TLBs, warming caches, disabling interrupts, flushing the target cache line, and performing the flip and data access within a tight serialized window before restoring the mapping.

Since the DRAM controller's address transform is a GF(2) linear map, the researchers recover the unknown transformation using the z3 SMT solver. They collect (target, alias) address pairs by writing a sentinel value through the scrambled mapping and sweeping memory to locate it, then solve for the translation matrix that connects the coherent and spaghettified views of memory. This allows them to compute aliases for any protected physical address. The technique extends conceptually to modern AMD processors, ARM, and RISC-V, whose datasheets omit these register details.
chinese_title: 将DRAM意面化
chinese_summary:
本文描述了一个名为“skitter-creek-bath-salts”的硬件安全研究项目，该项目利用AMD Family 16h CPU上的DRAM地址加扰机制，绕过内存保护并访问本应锁定的平台区域。

核心漏洞位于内存控制器（MCT/DCT）层，即虚拟到物理内存转换管线的最后一个阶段。DRAM控制器使用供应商可配置的变换方式，将物理地址重写为原始DRAM坐标（bank、row、column）。只需对DCT的bank-swizzle-mode寄存器执行一次单比特写入（`xor dword [0xf80c2094], 0x00400000`），即可打乱这一映射，导致物理地址别名映射到不同的DRAM单元。关键问题在于，保护受保护区（平台安全处理器、SMM、C6 DRAM、微码）的安全栅栏作用于内存控制器*之上*的物理地址，完全看不到下方的重映射——因此这些保护被悄然绕过。

在加扰过程中保持系统稳定需要精心的编排：禁用应用处理器、预填充TLB、预热缓存、禁用中断、刷新目标缓存行，并在恢复映射之前在紧凑的串行化窗口内完成比特翻转和数据访问。

由于DRAM控制器的地址变换是一个GF(2)线性映射，研究人员使用z3 SMT求解器恢复未知的变换。他们通过加扰映射写入一个哨兵值，然后扫描内存定位该值，收集（目标地址，别名地址）配对，进而求解连接一致视图与“意大利面条式”内存视图的转换矩阵。这使他们能够计算出任何受保护物理地址的别名。该技术从概念上可扩展到现代AMD处理器、ARM和RISC-V，这些平台的数据手册均未公开这些寄存器细节。

title: Choose Boring Technology (2015)
summary:
The article argues that companies should favor “boring,” well-established technology over trendy innovations for most problems. It introduces the idea that every company has roughly **three “innovation tokens”** to spend on novel technical choices; wasting them on things like new databases or niche infrastructure can delay success or cause failure. Boring technology—such as MySQL, Postgres, Python, PHP, Memcached, and Cron—is valuable because its capabilities **and failure modes** are well understood. New technology carries more “unknown unknowns,” increasing operational risk.

Technology choices should be optimized globally, not locally. Adding languages, databases, or services creates “baggage” in the form of monitoring, maintenance, cognitive overhead, and operational complexity. The “best tool for the job” mindset is myopic; the best tool is often the one that creates the least long-term operational burden across the whole organization.

However, the article is not against all new technology. Companies should adopt new tools **occasionally and deliberately**, through a company-wide conversation. Before adding anything, ask how to solve the problem with existing tools—often this reveals that the motivation is simply a desire to use something new. If a new technology is justified, set clear migration plans and avoid accumulating locally optimal but globally costly systems.

Ultimately, the goal is to **ship and keep the company in business**. Mindful, boring technology choices free engineering teams to focus on bigger problems, while polyglot or trend-driven choices can create operational toil that slows everything down.
chinese_title: 选择无聊的技术（2015）
chinese_summary:
这篇文章认为，对于大多数问题，公司应该倾向于选择“无聊”的、成熟稳定的技术，而非时髦的创新技术。文章提出了一个观点：每家公司大约只有**三个“创新代币”**，可以花在新技术选择上；将它们浪费在新型数据库或小众基础设施上，可能会延误成功，甚至导致失败。无聊的技术——如MySQL、Postgres、Python、PHP、Memcached和Cron——之所以有价值，是因为它们的能力**以及故障模式**都已被充分了解。新技术则携带更多“未知的未知”，增加了运营风险。

技术选择应该从全局而非局部进行优化。增加语言、数据库或服务会带来“包袱”，表现为监控、维护、认知负担和运营复杂度的上升。“为工作选择最佳工具”的心态是短视的；最好的工具往往是那种在整个组织范围内造成最少长期运营负担的工具。

然而，文章并非反对所有新技术。公司应该**偶尔且有意识地**采用新工具，并通过全公司范围内的讨论来推进。在添加任何东西之前，先问问如何用现有工具解决这个问题——这往往能揭示出，真正的动机只是想要尝试新东西。如果新技术确实合理，就要制定清晰的迁移计划，避免积累局部最优但全局昂贵的系统。

归根结底，目标是**交付产品并让公司持续经营下去**。审慎的、无聊的技术选择能让工程团队腾出精力专注于更大的问题，而多语言混用或追逐潮流的选择则可能制造运营负担，拖慢一切。

title: Where did the old web go? We followed 657,607 links to find out
summary:
A 2026 restoration of 0.mk, Macedonia’s first URL shortener, recovered a database of 657,607 links created between 2009 and 2014. Crawling every destination, researchers found that 76.7% of safe, crawlable records no longer returned a loading page: 51.24% failed at the network layer (DNS, timeout, TLS) and 25.44% returned HTTP errors. At the unique-URL level (492,620 crawlable URLs), only 21.3% loaded; the most common error was 404. Even successful loads often meant parked domains or login walls, not preserved content.

By domain, 98,778 of 133,605 hostnames had no URL that loaded. Large platforms like YouTube, Wikipedia, and Google survived far better than personal blogs, forums, local news sites, and photo CDNs. For example, none of 789 distinct Facebook CDN URLs loaded, while Google Code and PureVolume still responded. The 2011 spike was caused by one account’s 83,398 links to a single tutorial site, skewing annual URL-level percentages.

The data also captures a vanished national web: links to Macedonian newspapers and TV that shut down years ago. Notable finds include the first link ever shortened (a CSS file), a link to localhost, a 38,753-character test URL, chains of shorteners now broken by goo.gl’s 2025 shutdown, and 0.mk/7 still pointing to Google after 95,999 clicks. The project returned because AI now handles spam detection, support, and monitoring, making the service financially viable again. The crawl followed up to five redirects and retried failed connections from a second network.
chinese_title: 旧网络去哪了？我们追踪了657,607条链接找到了答案
chinese_summary:
2026年，对马其顿首个URL缩短服务0.mk的恢复工作找回了一个数据库，其中包含2009年至2014年间创建的657,607个链接。研究人员抓取每一个目标后发现，76.7%的安全、可抓取记录不再返回可加载页面：51.24%在网络层失败（DNS、超时、TLS），25.44%返回HTTP错误。在唯一URL层面（492,620个可抓取URL），只有21.3%能加载；最常见的错误是404。即使是成功加载，通常也意味着停放域名或登录墙，而非保存的内容。

按域名统计，133,605个主机名中有98,778个没有任何能加载的URL。像YouTube、维基百科和谷歌这样的大型平台比个人博客、论坛、地方新闻网站和图片CDN存续情况好得多。例如，789个不同的Facebook CDN URL中没有一个能加载，而Google Code和PureVolume仍能响应。2011年的峰值是由一个账户对单个教程网站的83,398个链接造成的，扭曲了年度URL级别的百分比。

这些数据还捕捉到了一个已消失的全国性网络：指向多年前关闭的马其顿报纸和电视台的链接。值得注意的发现包括：有史以来第一个被缩短的链接（一个CSS文件）、一个指向localhost的链接、一个38,753字符的测试URL、因goo.gl在2025年关闭而断裂的缩短器链，以及0.mk/7在95,999次点击后仍指向谷歌。该项目回归是因为现在由AI处理垃圾邮件检测、支持和监控，使这项服务在财务上再次可行。抓取最多跟踪五次重定向，并会从第二个网络重试失败的连接。

title: Understanding is the new bottleneck
summary:
This article is a written version of a talk from the AI Engineer conference (July 2026) arguing that understanding the code AI agents write remains essential, even as agents become more capable.

**Why understanding matters:** The goal is not merely to verify agents' work—agents are increasingly good at self-verification. Instead, we understand to *participate* in the creative process. A project involves many human-AI loops, and understanding the code gives us the conceptual fluency to form new ideas and evolve the system. Lacking this understanding creates "cognitive debt" that compounds over time.

**How to build understanding efficiently:** The author draws inspiration from education and offers three techniques.

1. **Explanations:** The `/explain-diff` skill generates well-structured code explainers. They teach background context first, build intuition before showing detail (often with interactive figures), and present code as "literate diffs"—prose-based walkthroughs rather than alphabetical file listings. Each explainer ends with a short quiz; the author refuses to share code until he can pass it, using quizzes as a "speed regulator" against AI's fast loops.

2. **Micro-worlds:** Inspired by Seymour Papert's "Mathland," these are interactive environments that let you experience a system first-hand. Examples include a custom debugger for a Prolog interpreter and a video-game-style "command center" for running a website migration step-by-step, building understanding as if doing it by hand but faster.

3. **Shared spaces:** Teams need shared mental models to collaborate creatively. Using shared environments (like Notion, where agents and humans can work on the same pages) enables immediate discussion and joint understanding.

The author concludes by referencing Alan Kay's 50-year-old vision of computers as tools to augment human thinking. AI now makes such simulations accessible, allowing humans to go *deeper* into the loop, not out of it.
chinese_title: 理解是新的瓶颈
chinese_summary:
本文是2026年7月AI工程师大会上一场演讲的文字版，旨在论证：即使AI智能体变得越来越强大，理解它们所编写的代码仍然至关重要。

**为什么理解很重要：** 目标并不仅仅是验证智能体的工作——智能体在自我验证方面已经越来越擅长。相反，我们理解代码是为了*真正参与*创造过程。一个项目涉及许多人机循环，理解代码能让我们具备概念上的熟练度，从而形成新想法、推动系统演进。缺乏这种理解会产生“认知债务”，并且会随时间不断累积。

**如何高效地建立理解：** 作者从教育中汲取灵感，提出了三种技巧。

1. **解释说明：** `/explain-diff`技能能够生成结构清晰的代码讲解。它们先介绍背景知识，在展示细节前先建立直觉（通常配有交互式图表），并以“文学式diff”的形式呈现代码——即用叙述性文字逐步讲解，而不是按字母顺序罗列文件。每份讲解都以一个小测验结尾；作者坚持要通过测验才肯分享代码，把测验当作制约AI快速迭代的“速度调节器”。

2. **微世界：** 受西摩·帕尔特“数学王国”的启发，微世界是让你能够亲身体验系统的交互式环境。例如，为Prolog解释器定制的调试器，以及一个电子游戏风格的“指挥中心”，用于一步步执行网站迁移——就像亲手操作一样建立理解，但速度更快。

3. **共享空间：** 团队需要共享心智模型才能进行创造性协作。使用共享环境（如Notion，智能体和人类可以在同一页面上工作）能够促进即时讨论和共同理解。

作者最后引用了艾伦·凯50年前的愿景——计算机是增强人类思维的工具。如今，AI让这样的模拟变得触手可及，使人类能够更*深入*地进入循环，而不是退出循环。

title: Single log line is 49KB+ (ext4) / 110KB+ (btrfs) of systemd-journald disk writes
summary:
The article is a GitHub issue report titled "Excessive IO caused by systemd-journald" (#40262), filed against systemd version 257.9 on Debian 13 with kernel 6.12.57. The user reports that journald causes excessive disk I/O: a VM performing only ~50 IOPS while writing just 2 lines of log per second. They provide sample haproxy log lines as examples of the log stream.

The reporter argues that log writes should be within an order of magnitude of syslog's overhead, but journald's storage format is extremely inefficient. The title states that a single log line can result in 49KB or more of disk writes on ext4 and 110KB+ on btrfs. They also claim that journal files are multiple times larger than the actual log content, and note experience with journald corruption after unclean reboots, questioning its resilience.

The issue explicitly references a previous similar report (#15292) that was closed without what the user considers good reason. The user dismisses a prior counterargument that iotop is inaccurate, noting that observed traffic persists even after kernel write coalescing mechanisms are accounted for. title: Idol Mahjong Final Romance: A Slideshow Disguised as a Video Game
summary:
Video System’s 1991 arcade game *Idol Mahjong Final Romance* is a strip mahjong title and part of a series. The original 1988 game, *Idol Mahjong Housoukyoku*, was never re-released, unlike the later entries collected in *Final Romance 2-R-4 Special*.

Gameplay is simple: the player faces eight women in a fixed order, playing riichi mahjong against each. Winning three rounds causes the opponent to remove clothing. Between stages, an item shop sells useful items, such as a redraw option that can be used after viewing the initial hand. The AI can call *chii* and *pon*. The game is more mahjong-focused than some contemporaries; the girl is not shown during matches. Its visuals use rotoscoped photographs of women, but with low frame-rate animation and a “slideshow” feel. Scenes fade in in separate palette blocks.

The PCB (VS-Z80-7) is nearly identical to *Mahjong Daiyogen* (VS-Z80-6). It uses two 6MHz Z80 CPUs, a YM2413 FM synthesizer, and an OKI MSM5205 ADPCM chip. The master CPU handles logic and input, while the sub CPU controls audio and video. The audio circuit has a constant buzz. The video system relies on discrete logic and a V-System GGA chip, with two scrolling tilemaps using unusual 8x4 tiles. This limited hardware means little on-screen movement; tiles jump into place and full-screen text overlays are the main animation.

The sequel, *Taisen Idol Mahjong Final Romance 2* (1995), released on Neo Geo CD, allowed linked two-player arcade play. Its single-player mode is similar, but the artwork switched from rotoscoped photos to anime style. This shift likely reflects anime’s growing popularity, though rights issues involving the models may also explain it. The modern re-release omitted the original game, possibly for similar reasons.
chinese_title: 偶像麻将 Final Romance：伪装成电子游戏的幻灯片
chinese_summary:
Video System 1991年的街机游戏《偶像麻将 Final Romance》是一款脱衣麻将游戏，也是该系列的一部分。1988年的原版游戏《偶像麻将放送局》从未被重新发行，与后来收录于《Final Romance 2-R-4 Special》中的后续作品不同。

游戏玩法简单：玩家按固定顺序面对八位女性，与她们逐一进行立直麻将。赢下三局后，对手会脱去衣物。在关卡之间，道具商店出售实用道具，例如在查看初始手牌后可以使用的重抽选项。AI可以叫吃和碰。与同时代的某些游戏相比，这款游戏更侧重于麻将本身；对局期间不会显示女性角色。其画面使用真人女性的转描照片，但帧率动画较低，带有“幻灯片”的感觉。场景以分色块淡入的方式呈现。

PCB（VS-Z80-7）与《麻雀大予言》（VS-Z80-6）几乎完全相同。它使用两颗6MHz的Z80 CPU、一颗YM2413 FM合成器芯片和一颗OKI MSM5205 ADPCM芯片。主CPU处理逻辑和输入，副CPU控制音频和视频。音频电路有持续的嗡嗡声。视频系统依赖分立逻辑和一颗V-System GGA芯片，使用两张采用不寻常的8x4瓦片滚动地图。这种有限的硬件意味着屏幕上的运动很少；瓦片跳入到位和全屏文字叠加是主要的动画效果。

续作《对战偶像麻将 Final Romance 2》（1995年）在Neo Geo CD上发行，支持街机双人联机对战。其单人模式类似，但美术风格从转描照片转变为动漫风格。这一转变可能反映了动漫日益增长的 popularity，但涉及模特的版权问题也可能解释这一变化。现代重新发行版省略了原版游戏，可能也是出于类似的原因。

title: Tocharian Online
summary:
Tocharian Online introduces two closely related but distinct Indo-European languages, Tocharian A and Tocharian B, discovered along the Silk Road in Chinese Turkestan (Xinjiang). Tocharian A, also called East Tocharian or Turfanian, is found only around Turfan and Qārāšahr; Tocharian B, or Kuchean, appears across the whole region from Turfan to Tumšuq.

The surviving documents date from roughly the sixth to eighth centuries AD and consist mostly of Buddhist translations, with some secular texts—letters, caravan passes, graffiti—all in Tocharian B. This suggests Tocharian A may have been a liturgical language by then. Texts were written mainly in a variant of the Brāhmī script, with some Tocharian B in Manichean script.

The name “Tocharian” was proposed by Müller and by Sieg and Siegling, based on the Uyghur term *toxrï*, but is now considered a misnomer; the language was likely not that of the Indo-Scythians/Bactrians. In Tocharian A the people may have called themselves *ārśi*, while Tocharian B has the adjective *kuśiññe*.

Linguistically, Tocharian is the easternmost ancient Indo-European language and is a centum language, which challenged earlier geographical assumptions about the centum–satem division. It has a reduced phonetic inventory, with only voiceless stops, and developed new agglutinative noun cases, possibly due to prolonged contact with Central Asian languages. The page offers lessons, glossaries, dictionaries, and resources for studying Tocharian A and B.
chinese_title: 吐火罗语在线
chinese_summary:
吐火罗语在线介绍两种密切相关但不同的印欧语言——吐火罗语A和吐火罗语B，它们是在中国突厥斯坦（新疆）的丝绸之路上发现的。吐火罗语A，又称东吐火罗语或吐鲁番语，仅在吐鲁番和焉耆（Qārāšahr）附近发现；吐火罗语B，或称龟兹语，则出现在从吐鲁番到图木舒克（Tumšuq）的整个地区。

幸存文献的年代大约在公元六至八世纪，主要包括佛教译作，还有一些世俗文本——书信、商队通行证、涂鸦——全部使用吐火罗语B书写。这表明吐火罗语A在当时可能已成为一种仪式语言。文本主要使用婆罗米文的一种变体书写，部分吐火罗语B文本使用摩尼文书写。

“吐火罗”这一名称由穆勒（Müller）以及西格和西格林（Sieg and Siegling）根据回鹘语术语 *toxrï* 提出，但现在被认为是用词不当；该语言很可能并非印度-斯基泰人/巴克特里亚人的语言。在吐火罗语A中，人们可能自称 *ārśi*，而吐火罗语B中有形容词 *kuśiññe*。

从语言学角度看，吐火罗语是最东方的古代印欧语言，属于肯图姆语（centum language），这挑战了先前关于肯图姆–萨特姆划分的地理假设。它的语音系统简化，只有清塞音，并发展出新的黏着名词格，这可能是由于与中亚语言长期接触所致。该页面提供课程、词汇表、词典以及研究吐火罗语A和B的资源。

title: Kubernetes on Oxide: How customer needs shaped our integrations
summary:
In late 2024, customers wanted to run Kubernetes on Oxide, but no supported integrations existed. Matthew Sanabria, Oxide's first Solutions Software Engineer, was tasked with fixing this. Through a customer-driven feedback loop, his team built integrations across the Kubernetes lifecycle.

**Provisioning** produced three tools: a **Rancher node driver** (originally customer-submitted, then merged and published), an **Omni infrastructure provider** (built with Sidero Labs for Talos Linux, uncovering bugs like a FAT12/ISO 9660 filesystem probe issue), and **Cluster API Provider Oxide (CAPOx)**, a Kubernetes-native option built by teammates Josh and Brandon.

**Runtime reconciliation** came via the **Oxide Cloud Controller Manager (CCM)**, which keeps Kubernetes Node objects synchronized with Oxide instances and provides a durable extension point for future controllers.

For **LoadBalancer services**, Oxide lacked a native load balancer, so the team used floating IPs. This required publishing two entries in `status.loadBalancer.ingress` — the floating IP (Proxy mode) and the node's internal IP (VIP mode) — because Oxide transparently translates traffic to the internal IP. The solution supports `externalTrafficPolicy: Cluster`.

For **storage**, customers avoided Longhorn due to write amplification from stacked replication. The introduction of Oxide local disks provided a better backing. Luiz then wrote **RFD 595** for a native Oxide CSI Plugin. Prototyping hit a blocker: Oxide requires instances to be stopped for disk attach/detach, conflicting with Kubernetes' expectation of live attachment to running workers — a problem still to be solved.

Overall, the article shows how real customer workflows shaped each integration, exposing the next gap to tackle.
chinese_title: Oxide上的Kubernetes：客户需求如何塑造了我们的集成
chinese_summary:
2024年底，客户希望在 Oxide 上运行 Kubernetes，但当时没有受支持的集成。Oxide 的第一位解决方案软件工程师 Matthew Sanabria 的任务就是解决这个问题。通过客户驱动的反馈循环，他的团队构建了覆盖 Kubernetes 生命周期的集成。

**预置（Provisioning）** 产生了三个工具：**Rancher 节点驱动**（最初由客户提交，然后合并并发布）、**Omni 基础设施提供商**（与 Sidero Labs 合作为 Talos Linux 构建，发现了诸如 FAT12/ISO 9660 文件系统探测问题等 bug），以及 **Cluster API Provider Oxide (CAPOx)**，这是由同事 Josh 和 Brandon 构建的 Kubernetes 原生选项。

**运行时协调（Runtime reconciliation）** 通过 **Oxide Cloud Controller Manager (CCM)** 实现，它使 Kubernetes Node 对象与 Oxide 实例保持同步，并为未来的控制器提供了一个持久的扩展点。

对于 **LoadBalancer 服务**，Oxide 缺乏原生负载均衡器，因此团队使用了浮动 IP。这需要在 `status.loadBalancer.ingress` 中发布两个条目——浮动 IP（代理模式）和节点的内部 IP（VIP 模式）——因为 Oxide 会将流量透明地转换到内部 IP。该解决方案支持 `externalTrafficPolicy: Cluster`。

对于 **存储**，由于堆叠复制带来的写入放大问题，客户避免使用 Longhorn。Oxide 本地磁盘的引入提供了更好的支持。Luiz 随后为原生 Oxide CSI 插件编写了 **RFD 595**。原型设计遇到一个阻碍：Oxide 要求实例停止才能进行磁盘挂载/卸载，这与 Kubernetes 期望在运行中的工作节点上进行实时挂载相冲突——这个问题仍有待解决。

总的来说，这篇文章展示了真实的客户工作流如何塑造每个集成，并揭示下一个需要解决的缺口。

title: DeepSeek Harness developer preview
summary:
DeepSeek Harness is now in developer preview as an open-source, plugin-based agent harness. Built on the Cordis plugin system, every capability—models, tools, skills, sessions, sandboxes, storage, loops, scheduling, and UI—is a plugin that can be swapped, extended, or recomposed via configuration, without modifying core source code.

Every run is fully traceable: an append-only session log records everything the model sees, including system prompts, reasoning, tool calls, subagent scheduling, and context injections. The Trajectory view lets developers inspect these events by source, while resume, fork, search, and replay operate on the same event stream.

The harness supports multiple runtime modes:
- Standard mode: full coding agent with file editing, shell, search, skills, planning, goals, subagents, and workflows.
- Code mode: exposes tools through a TypeScript SDK, letting the model combine multi-step operations in one program.
- Minimal mode: two-tool agent (persistent bash and file editor) for benchmarking in minimal environments.
- Creator mode: adds runtime inspection, in-memory plugin testing, and preset-authoring guidance for building custom agent presets.

To get started, developers can launch the Web UI with `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web` or clone the full source from GitHub (`deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness`). The core plugins and APIs are still evolving during the preview. DeepSeek invites the developer community to join the ecosystem and explore agent capabilities using composable, reusable open-source infrastructure.

title: Come for ENIAC, Stay for UNIVAC and Skeduflo
summary: This blog post from the Kislak Center highlights the John Mauchly papers, focusing on his post-ENIAC innovations. It notes that while Mauchly and J. Presper Eckert invented ENIAC, the first general-purpose electronic computer, at Penn in 1946, they gained little recognition. The author’s favorite materials are not ENIAC-related but rather those from the UNIVAC Applications and Research Center (UARC), which Mauchly led from 1953 to 1959. There, instead of using computers to solve known problems, Mauchly sought new problems computers could solve, helping prove computers were essential for business and government. His team advanced programming, including pioneer Admiral Grace Murray Hopper. Later, Mauchly co-created Skeduflo, a suitcase-sized computer for construction scheduling using the Critical Path Method, and in 1967 predicted businessmen would carry computers in their pockets. After his death, Eckert eulogized him as brilliant but, more importantly, a good man. The post encourages readers to visit the collection and includes references to archival materials.
chinese_title: 为ENIAC而来，为UNIVAC和Skeduflo而留
chinese_summary: 这篇来自基斯拉克中心的博客文章重点介绍了约翰·莫奇利的论文，聚焦于他在ENIAC之后的创新。文章指出，尽管莫奇利和J.普雷斯珀·埃克特于1946年在宾夕法尼亚大学发明了ENIAC——第一台通用电子计算机，但他们获得的认可甚少。作者最喜欢的材料并非与ENIAC相关，而是莫奇利在1953年至1959年间领导的UNIVAC应用与研究中心（UARC）的资料。在那里，莫奇利不是用计算机解决已知问题，而是寻找计算机能够解决的新问题，从而帮助证明了计算机对企业和政府至关重要。他的团队推动了编程领域的发展，其中包括先驱者格蕾丝·默里·霍珀海军少将。后来，莫奇利与他人共同创造了Skeduflo——一种手提箱大小的计算机，用于使用关键路径法进行施工调度；1967年，他预测商人会把计算机装进口袋。他去世后，埃克特在悼词中称赞他不仅才华横溢，更重要的是，他是一个好人。文章鼓励读者参观该收藏，并附有档案资料的参考。

title: AI At Home Part 1: A Box Of Scraps
summary:
The author builds a home AI inference server entirely from cheap e-waste, aiming to keep AI technology local and self-controlled rather than dependent on cloud services. Facing a computer parts shortage, they scavenge four AMD V620 GPUs (32GB VRAM each, originally made for cloud gaming and never sold publicly, now cheap on eBay) and pair them with an old X299 motherboard and a Core i9 10900X CPU, chosen for its four PCIe slots and low cost. RAM and SSD are salvaged from other machines, and a 1600W power supply was oddly cheaper than a 1200W one.

The GPUs have no fans, so the author designs and 3D-prints custom shrouds to mount 10,000 RPM server fans, which are extremely loud. Initial boot issues required enabling Resizable BAR and MMIO High Size in the BIOS. After installing Ubuntu 24.04 and compiling llama.cpp, they tested models: Gemma4 fits on one card, while Deepseek V4 Flash loads but runs slowly (performance tuning is promised for the next chapter).

Since the motherboard couldn't control fans independently, they built an Arduino Nano-based fan controller and had the AI server write its own fan-control script. A memorable moment occurred when the model suggested a PyTorch workload to heat the GPUs, not realizing it was running on the same machine, causing a brief existential crisis. The box is now stable and ready for further optimization. The article includes links to the STL file and controller code.
chinese_title: 家庭AI第一部分：一盒零碎
chinese_summary:
作者完全利用廉价的电子垃圾搭建了一台家庭AI推理服务器，目标是让AI技术本地化、自主可控，而非依赖云服务。面对电脑零件短缺的困境，他淘到了四块AMD V620 GPU（每块32GB显存，原本为云游戏而生，从未公开发售，如今在eBay上价格便宜），并将其与一块老旧的X299主板和一颗Core i9 10900X CPU搭配使用——选择这颗CPU是看中它的四条PCIe插槽和低廉的价格。内存和固态硬盘则从其他机器上拆机获取，而1600W电源的价格居然比1200W的还便宜，颇为蹊跷。

这些GPU没有风扇，作者便自行设计并3D打印了定制导流罩，用来安装转速高达10000 RPM的服务器风扇，噪音极其惊人。初次启动时遇到问题，需要在BIOS中开启Resizable BAR和MMIO High Size。安装Ubuntu 24.04并编译llama.cpp后，他测试了模型：Gemma4可单卡运行，而Deepseek V4 Flash虽能加载但运行缓慢（性能调优留待下一章讲述）。

由于主板无法独立控制风扇转速，作者又搭建了一个基于Arduino Nano的风扇控制器，并让AI服务器自己编写风扇控制脚本。一个令人难忘的插曲是，模型建议用PyTorch工作负载来给GPU加热，却没意识到自己正运行在同一台机器上，引发了一场短暂的生存危机。如今这台机器已稳定运行，随时可以进一步优化。文中附有STL文件与控制器代码的链接。

title: How Gödel's Proof Works
summary:
In 1931, Kurt Gödel proved that no consistent set of axioms can be both complete and able to prove its own consistency, ending the dream of a complete mathematical foundation.

His method involved “Gödel numbering”: mapping every mathematical symbol, formula, and proof sequence to a unique integer using prime factorizations. This allowed statements about mathematics—metamathematical statements—to be expressed as arithmetical formulas.

Gödel then used substitution to create a self-referential formula, G. Roughly, G says: “The formula with Gödel number sub(n, n, 17) cannot be proved.” Through the numbering and substitution, G turns out to be talking about itself: G asserts “I cannot be proved.”

If G could be proved, the system would prove a falsehood, contradicting consistency. So G is unprovable. Yet G is true—it accurately describes that no proof exists. Therefore the axiom system is incomplete: there is a true statement it cannot prove.

Adding new axioms doesn’t help; Gödel showed a new true but unprovable statement Gʹ can always be constructed. This is his first incompleteness theorem.

His second theorem follows: if a set of axioms could prove its own consistency, that would imply it could prove G, which it cannot. Thus no consistent axiomatic system can establish its own consistency.

Gödel’s work killed the search for a complete, self-justifying mathematical system. It also revealed unprovable statements in mathematics and even in physics, suggesting that incompleteness may extend beyond math into reality itself.
chinese_title: 哥德尔的证明是如何运作的
chinese_summary:
1931年，库尔特·哥德尔证明了：任何一致的公理集都不可能既完备又能够证明其自身的一致性，这终结了建立完备数学基础的梦想。

他的方法涉及“哥德尔配数”：利用质因数分解，将每个数学符号、公式和证明序列映射到一个唯一的整数。这使得关于数学的陈述——元数学陈述——能够表示为算术公式。

哥德尔随后使用代入法构造了一个自指公式G。粗略地说，G表达的是：“具有哥德尔数sub(n, n, 17)的公式不可被证明。”通过配数和代入，G实际上是在谈论自身：G断言“我不可被证明”。

如果G可被证明，那么系统就证明了假命题，从而与一致性相矛盾。因此G不可证明。然而G是真的——它准确地描述了不存在证明这一事实。因此公理系统是不完备的：存在一个它无法证明的真命题。

添加新的公理也无济于事；哥德尔表明，总能构造出新的真却不可证明的陈述G′。这就是他的第一不完备性定理。

他的第二定理随之而来：如果一组公理能证明自身的一致性，那将意味着它能证明G，而它不能。因此，任何一致的公理化系统都无法确立自身的一致性。

哥德尔的工作终结了对完备且自证成数学体系的追求。它还揭示了数学乃至物理学中不可证明的陈述，表明不完备性或许不仅限于数学，还可能延伸至现实本身。

title: I built a 500k-domain search engine for makers in a weekend for $10
summary:
A developer built a personal search engine for 560,183 maker-focused homepages in a weekend for about $10. The system used a fetcher to grab homepage text, a rented GPU running a small language model (Gemma 4B) to generate summaries and tags, and a simple search UI. Key choices: only index homepages, discard raw HTML after summarization, and steer the crawl via a priority file rather than hard blocks.

Initial results were over 90% corporate, so they weighted queues to favor portfolios, zines, and software projects. Subdomain caps (e.g., 100 per root domain) prevented Tumblr/Neocities from dominating. A “steward” process sampled suspiciously large domains and auto-blocked 177 problem sites (mostly hotel/booking mills). The final index cost roughly $1 per 100k sites; a single rented GPU sustained ~600 summaries/minute. Empty or parked pages were skipped to avoid hallucinated summaries.

The main scaling pitfalls: category/tag fragmentation (671 categories, 121k tags, many one-off) and the need to manually merge or constrain taxonomy. The author recommends splitting fetch from summarization, weighting instead of blocking, capping subdomains, and building automated sink detection. Code is open-sourced (repo: Marlin); no hosted database is planned.

title: JDK 27 G1/Parallel/Serial GC Changes
summary:
JDK 27 brings about 350 GC changes in HotSpot, mostly refactorings (e.g., Atomic<T>) and bug fixes. Key updates:

- **G1 GC**: Now the default collector in all environments (JEP 523), replacing Serial GC where applicable. G1 no longer resizes the heap after Full GC based on `-XX:MinHeapFreeRatio`/`MaxHeapFreeRatio`; defaults changed to 0 and 100 to avoid conflicting heuristics. Adaptive concurrent marking is more resilient to adverse conditions. Fixed humongous objects being held alive by weak references. Cleanup pauses no longer update `MemoryPoolMXBean.getCollectionUsage()`. GCs that cannot find space are now counted in CPU usage, improving heap sizing.

- **Parallel GC**: Adaptive tenuring threshold can now decrease, not just increase, preventing premature promotion of younger objects. The heap now correctly expands when repeated large allocations cause Full GCs despite available headroom.

- **Serial GC**: No notable changes except losing default status in some environments.

- **All collectors**: TLAB sizing now avoids waste from many short-lived, lightly allocating threads. String deduplication logging and JFR events improved with “new unknown” strings and better byte counts.

The focus ahead remains on Automatic Heap Sizing. Thanks to contributors; with major refactorings complete, more time is available for future enhancements.
chinese_title: JDK 27 G1/Parallel/Serial GC 变更
chinese_summary:

- **G1 垃圾回收器**：现已在所有环境中成为默认回收器（JEP 523），在适用场景下取代 Serial 垃圾回收器。G1 在 Full GC 后不再根据 `-XX:MinHeapFreeRatio`/`MaxHeapFreeRatio` 调整堆大小；默认值已改为 0 和 100，以避免相互冲突的启发式策略。自适应并发标记对不利条件的适应能力更强。修复了巨型对象被弱引用持有而无法回收的问题。清理暂停不再更新 `MemoryPoolMXBean.getCollectionUsage()`。无法找到空间的垃圾回收现在会计入 CPU 使用率，从而改进堆大小调整。

- **Parallel 垃圾回收器**：自适应晋升阈值现在可以降低，而不仅仅是升高，防止年轻对象被过早晋升。当重复的大量分配导致 Full GC 但仍有可用空间时，堆现在能够正确扩展。

- **Serial 垃圾回收器**：除了在某些环境中失去默认状态外，没有显著变化。

- **所有回收器**：TLAB 大小调整现在可避免因大量短生命周期、低分配量线程造成的浪费。字符串去重日志和 JFR 事件得到改进，新增了 "new unknown" 字符串，并提供了更好的字节计数。

title: How Compaction Works in Pi
summary:
Pi is a coding agent that relies on LLMs with limited context windows. Each request includes system prompt, tools, loaded files, and full conversation history, which grows until it exceeds the limit, causing errors.

To avoid losing all context by starting over, Pi uses **compaction**: a process that summarizes older conversation content into a compressed representation, freeing room for new messages. The summary is created using a separate LLM request with a different system prompt (“context summarization assistant”) and a special user prompt asking for structured notes on goal, progress, and key decisions. This standalone request can even use a different model without extra cost.

Pi triggers compaction automatically when nearing the context limit, after a turn ends, or mid-turn if an overflow error occurs. It can also be manually triggered with `/compact`. During compaction, Pi retains a number of recent messages unchanged—default token budget is 20,000 tokens, roughly 5–20 turns. Everything older is serialized and summarized.

The compaction result is stored as plain text in the session, making it readable, portable, and usable even if models are switched.

One trade-off: compaction breaks **prompt caching**. Before compaction, the entire history was cached as a prefix. After compaction, the retained turns appear after a new summary token prefix, so the old cache cannot be reused; subsequent requests will rebuild caching from there.

The article also mentions that Pi is extensible, so users can create custom compaction prompts via extensions.
chinese_title: Pi 中压缩的工作原理
chinese_summary:
Pi 是一个依赖上下文窗口有限的 LLM 的编程代理。每个请求都包含系统提示、工具、加载的文件以及完整的对话历史，这些内容会不断增长，直到超出限制，从而导致错误。

为了避免从头开始而丢失所有上下文，Pi 使用 **压缩**：一种将较早的对话内容总结为压缩表示的过程，从而为新消息腾出空间。该摘要是通过一个单独的 LLM 请求生成的，该请求使用不同的系统提示（“上下文摘要助手”）和一个特殊的用户提示，要求对目标、进展和关键决策进行结构化记录。这个独立的请求甚至可以使用不同的模型，而无需额外成本。

Pi 会在接近上下文限制时、一轮结束后，或者如果在中途发生溢出错误时，自动触发压缩。也可以通过 `/compact` 手动触发。在压缩过程中，Pi 会保留一定数量的最近消息不变——默认令牌预算为 20,000 个令牌，大约 5–20 轮。所有更早的内容都会被序列化并总结。

压缩结果以纯文本形式存储在会话中，使其可读、可移植，即使切换模型也能使用。

一个权衡是：压缩会破坏 **提示缓存**。压缩前，整个历史记录作为前缀被缓存。压缩后，保留的轮次出现在新的摘要令牌前缀之后，因此旧缓存无法复用；后续请求将从那里重新构建缓存。

文章还提到 Pi 是可扩展的，因此用户可以通过扩展创建自定义的压缩提示。

title: AI Is Threatening Natural Resources for Billions
summary:
A UN University (UNU-INWEH) report warns that AI’s environmental toll is being mismeasured because most assessments focus only on carbon emissions. By 2030, global data-centre electricity demand is projected to reach 945 TWh, with a water footprint of 9.3 trillion litres—equal to the basic annual domestic water needs of 1.3 billion people in Sub-Saharan Africa—and a land footprint exceeding 14,500 km², roughly twice the Jakarta metro area.

The report stresses that “low-carbon” is not automatically low-water or low-land. Switching from coal to bioenergy can cut carbon footprints by 70% but increase water footprints thirty-fold and land footprints a hundred-fold. Evaluating AI sustainability by carbon alone can shift environmental burdens onto water- and land-stressed regions.

Inference—running deployed models—accounts for 80–90% of AI energy use, not training. ChatGPT alone processes about 2.5 billion prompts daily, using roughly 383 GWh per year. Per-query energy varies hugely: an AI image uses ~1,450 times the energy of basic text classification, and a short AI video can match 200,000 spam classifications. Efficiency gains may backfire via the rebound effect: cheaper AI leads to more use, wiping out per-query savings.

The benefits and burdens are unequal. 90% of AI-specialised compute capacity is concentrated in the US and China, while over 150 countries lack sovereign AI infrastructure yet bear extraction and e-waste costs. AI hardware could generate 2.5 million tonnes of e-waste annually by 2030. Local examples include Ireland, where data centres consumed 21% of electricity, and water stress in Mexico and Uruguay.

The report urges a six-principle framework: transparency, efficiency by design, equity and environmental justice, lifecycle responsibility, global cooperation, and sustainable use. It assigns actions to governments, industry, users, data-centre operators, investors, communities, and international institutions to make AI growth sustainable and equitable.

title: Show HN: OpenCode Senses, An insanely fast and highly accurate vision plugin
summary:
# OpenCode Senses — Summary

OpenCode Senses is a vision plugin that gives text-only OpenCode AI models the ability to "see" images, fully locally, privately, and free.

**Core concept:** When a user attaches an image, Senses analyzes it using the Moondream 2 vision model (running on your own GPU) and auto-injects structured evidence — scene description, caption, and exact OCR text — into the message before the text model responds. A Python runtime communicates with the TypeScript plugin via stdio JSON-RPC.

**Key features:**
- **13 grounded tools:** inspect, OCR, detect, point, segment, crop, zoom, colors, diff, annotate, metadata, reverse search, and status. All return normalized, source-grounded evidence.
- **Web image support:** any tool accepts HTTP(S) URLs; images download verbatim and cache locally.
- **Prompt-injection hardening:** text inside images is wrapped as untrusted data, so embedded "ignore instructions" text is treated as evidence, not commands.
- **Recovery-grade analysis:** zoom upscales regions to re-read small text; colors gives deterministic pixel ground truth.

**Requirements:** NVIDIA GPU (Ampere+) or Apple Silicon, 6 GB VRAM, Python 3.10–3.14 or `uv`. No API keys.

**Installation:** `npm install -g opencode-senses`, then add `"plugin": ["opencode-senses"]` to `opencode.jsonc`. On first use, Senses auto-provisions its own Python venv and downloads ~3.9 GB of model weights. Subsequent calls run sub-second from cache.

**Use cases:** debugging screenshots, extracting exact error messages, screenshot-to-code with grounded element positions, render QA via diffs, and research/media analysis — all without leaving the terminal or sending data off-machine.

**Configuration:** fully optional via environment variables (e.g., `SENSES_MODEL`, `SENSES_VENV_DIR`, `SENSES_DEBUG`).

title: Surfil On-device control plane for AI coding agents
summary:
Surfil is an on-device control plane for AI coding agents, designed to make them cheaper, safer, and more memory-aware. It installs once alongside Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, and 30+ other tools, connecting via CLI/MCP interception. Source code never leaves the machine, and uninstalling restores all configs byte-for-byte.

The product addresses three core problems: agents are expensive (re-sending context and re-reading files), risky (running shell commands and leaking keys), and forgetful (restarting from zero each session). Its solution sits on one shared pipeline with three main products: Cap (measures and reduces token spend), Guard (blocks secrets and injection attacks before execution), and Mind (encrypted, portable memory across agents). Core installs and bootstraps the system; additional products include Radar, Bench, and six others.

Trust is architectural: zero-trace data handling, Ed25519-signed receipts for every paid output, honest measured claims rather than fixed savings percentages, and a single interception point. Users can verify any receipt offline with `surfil verify`—no account needed.

Pricing is based on signed output, not execution: running agents is unmetered, while one server-signed value-output equals one Credit. Plans include Starter ($5/mo), recommended Pro ($25/mo), Team ($20/seat), and Enterprise (custom). Surfil claims no fixed savings rate because real savings depend on whether prompt caching is already in use; it guarantees byte-exact interception to avoid breaking provider caches and measures results per user’s own traffic.

title: Amazon will train on Twitch streamers' content by default, unless they opt out
summary:
Twitch will now allow Amazon to train generative AI models on streamers’ content by default, with creators required to manually opt out through a new setting. The move sparked immediate backlash, with many streamers concerned their videos and voices are being used without informed consent. Twitch framed the change as adding a privacy setting, but critics argue the default opt-in design hides the decision from users. Kish noted that other platforms, like Meta, also train AI on public user content, and that offering any opt-out reflects responsiveness to community concerns. To opt out, users must go to channel settings (not the Creator Dashboard), select the security and privacy tab, and toggle off “training for generative AI.”

The article highlights broader tensions between platforms and creators over AI training, especially since many streamers are strongly opposed to generative AI using scraped content. Twitch’s own messaging appeared to anticipate backlash, and the company’s lack of clarity about past data use added to the distrust. The move underscores how platforms often rely on passive consent, leaving users to navigate opt-outs rather than giving them an active choice.

title: Show HN: At 16K features, flat autoencoders break. Curved space doesn't
summary:
HyperSAE is a high-performance mechanistic interpretability engine that extracts hierarchical concept ontologies from LLM activations. It decouples hyperbolic geometry from the forward pass: a fast Euclidean path handles token activations for zero-latency execution, while a slow-path enforces hierarchical structure via Poincaré ball projections on decoder weights during optimization.

Benchmarked on Gemma-2-2B Layer 13 (d=2304, dictionary size=16384, 20M FineWeb-Edu tokens), HyperSAE outperforms standard flat SAEs. At matching sparsity (L0≈53), it achieves 9.8% lower reconstruction MSE (4.1232 vs 4.5724) and +3.4% higher CE loss recovery (78.9% vs 75.5%). At lower sparsity penalties, it also shows improved MSE and CE recovery, e.g., 98.1% CE recovery vs 97.0% for flat SAE.

Key components include: HyperSAE model (linear forward pass with learnable radial depths), CoActivationQueue (GPU memory-efficient co-occurrence tracking), TriPartiteLoss (combines MSE, L1 sparsity, and Poincaré entailment penalty), and FlatSAE baseline. The package provides PyTorch and TransformerLens hooks for steering.

Installation is via `pip install hypersae` or from source. The library supports training with a simple trainer API. The work is accompanied by two research papers: a theoretical paper on weight-space regularization and hyperbolic geometry, and an empirical validation paper. The project is MIT-licensed.

title: Tracking down the 16-year-old WAL-reset SQLite bug
summary:
Tailscale suffered 19 SQLite database corruption incidents over six months, causing outages and metadata loss. Their control plane uses SQLite with a single-writer design per shard, which should be safe and reliable. Initial investigations found no common trigger and couldn't reproduce the bug.

Tailscale enlisted help from the SQLite core developers and built a transaction-logging pipeline to aid recovery. This revealed a startling clue: data committed by one transaction was sometimes invisible to later transactions—an impossible scenario. The SQLite team developed a tracing shim (tmstmpvfs) to diagnose live incidents.

The logs exposed a rare data race between checkpoints and write transactions, named the "WAL-Reset bug." If a write occurs at a specific moment during a checkpoint, SQLite thinks pages were copied from the write-ahead log into the main database file, but they weren't. Those pages are permanently lost, corrupting the database. The bug likely existed for at least 16 years; Tailscale was disproportionately exposed because it runs manual, aggressive checkpointing.

SQLite 3.52.0 fixed the bug, but Tailscale's rollout triggered false corruption warnings caused by a second, unrelated bug involving stale expression indexes and changed rounding behaviour for text-to-floating-point conversions. SQLite withdrew 3.52.0 and released 3.51.3 containing only the WAL-Reset fix. Tailscale avoided the index issue by storing timestamps as integer seconds, and SQLite later added an automated self-healing index feature in 3.53.0. The fix resolved Tailscale's ongoing outages.
chinese_title: 追踪存在16年的SQLite WAL重置缺陷

Tailscale 在六个月内遭遇了19次 SQLite 数据库损坏事件，导致服务中断和元数据丢失。其控制平面每个分片采用单写入者设计，按理说应该安全可靠。初步调查未发现共同触发因素，也无法复现该 bug。

Tailscale 邀请了 SQLite 核心开发者协助，并构建了一个事务日志管道以帮助恢复。这揭示了一个惊人的线索：一个事务提交的数据有时对后续事务不可见——这是一个不可能出现的场景。SQLite 团队开发了一个跟踪垫片（tmstmpvfs）来诊断实时事件。

日志暴露出检查点与写事务之间罕见的数据竞争，称为“WAL-Reset bug”。如果在检查点期间某个特定时刻发生写入，SQLite 会误以为页面已从预写日志复制到主数据库文件，但实际上并未复制。这些页面永久丢失，导致数据库损坏。该 bug 可能至少存在了16年；Tailscale 之所以受影响尤为严重，是因为它运行了手动且激进的检查点操作。

SQLite 3.52.0 修复了该 bug，但 Tailscale 的部署触发了虚假的损坏警告，原因在于另一个无关的 bug，涉及过期的表达式索引以及文本到浮点数转换的舍入行为变化。SQLite 撤回了 3.52.0，并发布了仅包含 WAL-Reset 修复的 3.51.3。Tailscale 通过将时间戳存储为整数秒来避免索引问题，而 SQLite 后来在 3.53.0 中增加了自动自愈索引功能。该修复解决了 Tailscale 持续发生的中断问题。

title: Namecheap has been down for six hours
summary:

To prevent equipment overheating and long-term damage, Namecheap intentionally took affected services offline. Two of four chillers have been restored, temperatures are dropping, and the third chiller is expected online in about three hours, after which services should begin to be restored. Additional cooling units are also being installed.

The incident affects more than 5,000 servers and has disrupted Namecheap.com, shared/VPS/dedicated hosting, EasyWP, DNS, Private Email and hosting email, email forwarding, URL redirects, and some hosting operations. Websites and services may be unavailable, slow, or return errors until infrastructure is safely brought back online. For email, delivery may be delayed, but messages are not expected to be lost; sending servers should retry once connectivity is restored.

CEO Hillan Klein apologized for the disruption, saying the company takes its responsibility seriously and is working around the clock with PhoenixNAP to restore cooling and services safely and quickly. Updates will be provided as progress is made.

title: Build a Stratum 1 PTP Grandmaster on a Budget
summary:
This article documents building a budget Stratum 1 PTP grandmaster clock for about $103 using a Raspberry Pi CM4 and IO board, a $15 u-blox SR1723U10 GPS module, and an active antenna. The CM4's BCM54210PE Ethernet PHY supports IEEE 1588v2 hardware timestamping, enabling nanosecond-level synchronization.

The author used Ubuntu 24.04, which provides kernel support for the PHY's PTP hardware clock (absent in 22.04). The software stack pairs SatPulse (GPS-to-PHC discipline) with ptp4l (PTP grandmaster daemon) and chrony (NTP server). GPS connects via UART, with the PPS signal wired to the PHY's SYNC_OUT timestamp input.

Several bugs required workarounds: the PHY driver initializes SYNC_OUT as output instead of input, requiring a pin toggle before startup; the IO board's RTC needed an overlay enabling; and service ordering had to be enforced so SatPulse starts after chrony/ptp4l create their sockets.

Results: the grandmaster PHC stayed within 18ns of GPS truth (mean offset 6.4ns). A CM4 client achieved ±66ns uncertainty via PTP hardware timestamping; an RK1 client managed ±291ns (MAC-layer instead of PHY-layer timestamping). For comparison, LAN NTP from the same grandmaster gave microsecond offsets, and WAN NTP gave milliseconds. Network topology mattered: routing through a consumer router raised path delay to ~480µs versus 2.6µs direct to the lab switch — a 180x degradation.

Holdover without GPS (no TCXO) drifted ~15ms over 10 hours, acceptable for learning but inferior to the ~$475 TimeHAT alternative with its temperature-compensated oscillator and cleaner integration.
chinese_title: 如何在有限预算下构建一台 Stratum 1 PTP 主时钟
chinese_summary:
本文记录了如何利用树莓派 CM4 和 IO 板、一块 15 美元的 u-blox SR1723U10 GPS 模块以及一根有源天线，以约 103 美元的成本构建一台经济型 Stratum 1 PTP 主时钟。CM4 的 BCM54210PE 以太网 PHY 支持 IEEE 1588v2 硬件时间戳，从而实现纳秒级同步。

作者使用了 Ubuntu 24.04，其内核为该 PHY 的 PTP 硬件时钟提供了支持（22.04 中不具备）。软件栈将 SatPulse（GPS 到 PHC 的驯服）与 ptp4l（PTP 主时钟守护进程）和 chrony（NTP 服务器）搭配使用。GPS 通过 UART 连接，PPS 信号接入 PHY 的 SYNC_OUT 时间戳输入。

有几个 bug 需要变通处理：PHY 驱动程序将 SYNC_OUT 初始化为输出而非输入，因此启动前需要切换一次引脚状态；IO 板的 RTC 需要启用 overlay；还必须强制规定服务启动顺序，确保 SatPulse 在 chrony/ptp4l 创建套接字之后再启动。

结果：主时钟 PHC 与 GPS 真实时间的偏差保持在 18ns 以内（平均偏移 6.4ns）。CM4 客户端通过 PTP 硬件时间戳实现了 ±66ns 的不确定度；RK1 客户端实现了 ±291ns（使用 MAC 层而非 PHY 层时间戳）。作为对比，从同一主时钟通过局域网 NTP 同步得到微秒级偏移，而广域网 NTP 得到毫秒级偏移。网络拓扑也很关键：经由消费级路由器转发时，路径延迟升至约 480µs，而直连实验室交换机仅为 2.6µs——相差 180 倍。

无 GPS 时的保持能力（无 TCXO）在 10 小时内漂移约 15ms，对于学习目的可以接受，但不如约 475 美元的 TimeHAT 替代方案——后者配备温补振荡器，集成度也更高。

title: Cloudflare Durable Objects, Ported to Rails
summary:
Solid Objects is a library that ports Cloudflare Durable Objects to the Ruby on Rails stack (with a parallel TypeScript/Node.js version). It provides "stateful, real-time virtual actors" powered entirely by an existing relational database — Postgres, MySQL, or SQLite — eliminating the need for Redis, message brokers, or a separate state service.

In Rails, Solid Objects delivers "the easiest reactive ERB there has ever been": developers define an actor class with attributes and methods, drop it into an ERB template via `solid_object`, and the view live-updates in every open browser the moment state changes — with no channels, broadcasts, Stimulus controllers, or handwritten JavaScript. Durable, ordered virtual actors handle race safety: all calls to one actor are serialized through a mailbox, committed to the DB, and protected by leases and fencing.

Key capabilities include:
- **Durable timers/alarms** scheduled per object.
- **Transactional outbox** for actor-to-actor messages, effects, and invalidations committed alongside state.
- **Live UI sync** via Action Cable/Turbo Streams, with authorization policies for mutations, reads, and subscriptions.
- **Personalized broadcast payloads** so private data (e.g., each player's hand) never crosses sessions.
- **Live components** that re-render server-side with Turbo morphs, batchable refreshes, and signed keys.

The article lists four guarantees new to Rails: per-entity locking without Redis, background work without a broker, timer tables replaced by DB-backed alarms, and (implicitly) the realtime streaming layer. A production reference app, MTG Playmat, demonstrates the approach running on Rails 8 and SQLite.
chinese_title: Cloudflare持久对象，移植到Rails
chinese_summary:
Solid Objects 是一个将 Cloudflare Durable Objects 移植到 Ruby on Rails 技术栈的库（同时提供 TypeScript/Node.js 版本）。它提供“有状态的、实时的虚拟 actor”，完全由现有的关系数据库（Postgres、MySQL 或 SQLite）驱动，无需 Redis、消息代理或独立的状态服务。

在 Rails 中，Solid Objects 实现了“有史以来最简单的响应式 ERB”：开发者定义一个带有属性和方法的 actor 类，通过 `solid_object` 将其放入 ERB 模板，状态一变，视图就会在所有打开的浏览器中实时更新——无需 channels、broadcasts、Stimulus 控制器或手写 JavaScript。持久、有序的虚拟 actor 处理竞态安全：对同一 actor 的所有调用都通过邮箱串行化，提交到数据库，并通过租约和 fencing 保护。

主要能力包括：
- **持久化定时器/闹钟**：按对象调度。
- **事务性发件箱**：用于 actor 间消息、效果和失效操作，与状态一起提交。
- **实时 UI 同步**：通过 Action Cable/Turbo Streams，并带有针对变更、读取和订阅的授权策略。
- **个性化广播负载**：确保私有数据（如每个玩家的手牌）不会跨会话传递。
- **实时组件**：使用 Turbo morphs 在服务端重新渲染，支持批量刷新和签名密钥。

文章列出了 Rails 新增的四个保证：无需 Redis 的按实体锁定、无需代理的后台工作、由数据库支持的闹钟取代定时器表，以及（隐式的）实时流层。生产级参考应用 MTG Playmat 演示了在 Rails 8 和 SQLite 上运行的这种方法。
